name: getuid
description: getuid() returns the real user ID of the calling process. geteuid() returns the effective user ID of the calling process.

return_value.success: Returns the real user ID for getuid(), or the effective user ID for geteuid()
return_value.failure: These functions are always successful and never fail

bugs: The original Linux getuid() and geteuid() supported only 16-bit user IDs; Linux 2.4 added support for 32-bit IDs via wrapper functions. On Alpha systems, a single getxuid() system call is used instead, handled transparently by glibc.
